messages:
sam_devex: quick sketch from today's design review — proposing a 'tool chip' row in the playground run history that groups tool-calls by invocation and shows schema diff/timestamp compactly. thoughts?

maria_design: nice. can you paste the visual? even a tiny ascii helps. wondering how it handles long tool names.

sam_devex: sure — rough idea: 
```
[Model output]
- tool-chip: TranslateText v2 • 3 calls • latest schema: text:string -> language:enum
  • 12:34:56 • diff(expanded)
- tool-chip: FetchUserProfile • 1 call • schema valid
```

noah_eng: +1 for grouping. runtime note: if we collapse too aggressively we lose per-call latencies. maybe show avg + p95 inline?

lee_prod: agree with noah. also we need a fallback when schema validation fails — show error badge and one-tap revert to previous schema.

ashley_a11y: a11y nits: chips need 2rem hit target, keyboard focus ring, and ARIA label like "tool invocation group: TranslateText, 3 calls". color contrast for badges must meet 4.5:1.

maria_design: copy tweak suggestion: instead of "diff(expanded)" use "schema changes" and the expand state should preserve across paged history.

sam_devex: good point re persist. also thinking a small inline badge for "structured output" vs "free text" so users can scan. icon + short label.

lee_prod: UX question — when a tool schema changes, do we auto-rewrite old run history entries or display them as "schema at time of run"? We should preserve historical schema snapshot.

noah_eng: preserve snapshots. storage cheap compared to confusion. but add a toggle: "Show run using current schema" which runs an ad-hoc reenact.

ashley_a11y: keyboard flow: tab into run history, arrow across chips, Enter expands the diff panel, Esc closes. Screen reader should announce "expanded schema diff, 3 changes" when opened.

ci-bot: deploy-checks: please add unit tests for run-history rendering with 0, 1, >1 tool-calls and with long tool ids. CI will fail otherwise. :robot_face:

sam_devex: actionable list I captured: 1) tool-chip compact row with avg/p95, 2) schema snapshot per-run + expand diff, 3) preserve expand state across paging, 4) badges for structured/free + a11y labels, 5) revert / reenact affordances, 6) tests for edge cases. anyone want to reorder or add?

maria_design: reorder: put structured/free badge leftmost, then tool name, then counts, then timing, then diff affordance. also mock micro-copy for badges: "Structured output" / "Unstructured".

lee_prod: add: throttle UI for runs that call many tools (collapse into "+8 more" with a single expand).

noah_eng: perf note: avoid expanding diff for >20 runs by default. lazy-load diffs.

ashley_a11y: last: ensure color is not the only signal — use icons and text because of colorblind users.

sam_devex: perfect. I'll update the prototype and post new PNG. thanks all — will ping when ready. :tada:
